context.build_profile: release with app-benchmark; caller must build the GPUI executable
context.filesystem_cache: warm/uncontrolled; cold means fresh application SQLite cache only
context.display: same active display; refresh rate not forced; record hardware separately
context.launch_method: NSWorkspace LaunchServices new-instance foreground activation; exact PID returned
context.termination_validation: process disappeared + validated atomic successful report; native exit status unavailable
context.attribution: verified app responsible PID (capability-tested undocumented macOS API)
context.background_load: existing user applications left running; background workload not neutralized

cpu_timebase_normalization.method: Mach user+system ticks converted to nanoseconds in the process reader before phase deltas

runs.readiness_proxy: state-ready observed at frame cadence then subsequent GPUI platform submission
runs.frame_proxy: GPUI platform submission intervals (not display scanout)
